p: journeys of the children of Israel: From which they departed, and where they came.
gods also the LORD executed judgments: Either meaning their idols, or their men of authority.
Pihahiroth: At the commandment of the Lord in Ex 14:2.
fifth month: Which the Hebrews call Ab, and contains part of July and part of August.
pictures: Which were set up in their high places to worship.
